import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
sc=bpy.context.scene
def mat(name,col,rough=0.5,metal=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes=True
    b=m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']; b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*col,1)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal
    m.diffuse_color=(*col,1); return m
M_asph=mat('Asphalt',(0.06,0.06,0.07),0.9); M_grass=mat('Grass',(0.12,0.35,0.08),1)
M_line=mat('Line',(0.9,0.9,0.9)); M_kerbR=mat('KerbRed',(0.8,0.05,0.05)); 
M_body=mat('CarBody',(0.95,0.45,0.02),0.3,0.2); M_dark=mat('CarDark',(0.03,0.03,0.035),0.6)
M_tire=mat('Tire',(0.02,0.02,0.02),0.9); M_glass=mat('Visor',(0.1,0.2,0.35),0.1)
M_accent=mat('Accent',(0.05,0.25,0.8),0.3)

# --- circuit centerline: rounded rectangle
W,H,R=40.0,20.0,10.0  # half extents, corner radius
pts=[]
def arc(cx,cy,a0,a1,n=16):
    return [(cx+R*math.cos(a0+(a1-a0)*i/n), cy+R*math.sin(a0+(a1-a0)*i/n)) for i in range(n+1)]
segs=[]
segs+= [(-W+R,-H),(W-R,-H)]
segs+= arc(W-R,-H+R,-math.pi/2,0)[1:]
segs+= [(W,H-R)]
segs+= arc(W-R,H-R,0,math.pi/2)[1:]
segs+= [(-W+R,H)]
segs+= arc(-W+R,H-R,math.pi/2,math.pi)[1:]
segs+= [(-W,-H+R)]
segs+= arc(-W+R,-H+R,math.pi,1.5*math.pi)[1:-1]
# densify straight segments
center=[]
n=len(segs)
for i in range(n):
    a=Vector(segs[i]); b=Vector(segs[(i+1)%n])
    k=max(1,int((b-a).length/2.0))
    for j in range(k): center.append(a.lerp(b,j/k))
def strip(name,offs_in,offs_out,z,material):
    bm=bmesh.new(); N=len(center); vi=[];vo=[]
    for i in range(N):
        p=center[i]; t=(center[(i+1)%N]-center[i-1]).normalized(); nrm=Vector((t.y,-t.x))  # outward-ish (right side)
        vi.append(bm.verts.new((*(p+nrm*offs_in),z))); vo.append(bm.verts.new((*(p+nrm*offs_out),z)))
    for i in range(N):
        j=(i+1)%N; bm.faces.new((vi[i],vo[i],vo[j],vi[j]))
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    for f in me.polygons:
        if f.normal.z<0: pass
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(material)
    me.flip_normals() if me.polygons[0].normal.z<0 else None
    return o
strip('Track',-5,5,0.0,M_asph)
strip('Kerb_Outer',5,6,0.02,M_kerbR)
strip('Kerb_Inner',-6,-5,0.02,M_kerbR)
strip('CenterLine',-0.12,0.12,0.01,M_line)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=200,location=(0,0,-0.02)); g=bpy.context.object; g.name='Ground'; g.data.materials.append(M_grass)
# start/finish line
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(location=(-20,-H,0.015)); s=bpy.context.object; s.name='StartLine'; s.scale=(0.6,5,1); s.data.materials.append(M_line)
print(len(center))

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene; D=bpy.data
root=D.objects.new('RaceCar',None); sc.collection.objects.link(root); root.empty_display_size=1
def mesh_obj(name,verts,faces,material):
    me=D.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update()
    o=D.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); o.parent=root; o.data.materials.append(D.materials[material]); return o
def box(name,c,s,material,taper=None):
    # s = half sizes; taper: (front_scale_x, front_scale_z) applied to +Y face
    x,y,z=s; fx,fz=taper or (1,1)
    v=[(-x,-y,-z),(x,-y,-z),(x,-y,z),(-x,-y,z),(-x*fx,y,-z),(x*fx,y,-z),(x*fx,y,-z+2*z*fz),(-x*fx,y,-z+2*z*fz)]
    v=[(a+c[0],b+c[1],d+c[2]) for a,b,d in v]
    f=[(0,3,2,1),(4,5,6,7),(0,1,5,4),(2,3,7,6),(1,2,6,5),(0,4,7,3)]
    return mesh_obj(name,v,f,material)
# main chassis tub (tapering to nose)
box('Chassis',(0,0.2,0.38),(0.55,1.6,0.2),'CarBody',taper=(0.45,0.55))
box('Nose',(0,2.25,0.3),(0.22,0.5,0.1),'CarBody',taper=(0.5,0.6))
# side pods
box('Pod_L',(-0.72,-0.2,0.36),(0.22,0.9,0.18),'CarBody',taper=(1,0.5))
box('Pod_R',(0.72,-0.2,0.36),(0.22,0.9,0.18),'CarBody',taper=(1,0.5))
# engine cover / fin
box('EngineCover',(0,-0.9,0.68),(0.3,0.8,0.15),'Accent',taper=(0.6,0.5))
# cockpit opening & visor
box('Cockpit',(0,0.45,0.6),(0.28,0.4,0.03),'CarDark')
box('Visor',(0,0.85,0.66),(0.3,0.08,0.1),'Visor',taper=(0.9,0.4))
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=8,ring_count=5,radius=0.17,location=(0,0.35,0.75))
h=bpy.context.object; h.name='Helmet'; h.parent=root; h.data.materials.append(D.materials['Accent'])
# front wing
box('FrontWing',(0,2.6,0.12),(0.95,0.25,0.03),'Accent')
box('FW_End_L',(-0.95,2.6,0.2),(0.03,0.28,0.1),'CarDark')
box('FW_End_R',(0.95,2.6,0.2),(0.03,0.28,0.1),'CarDark')
# rear wing
box('RearWing',(0,-1.95,1.0),(0.75,0.22,0.04),'Accent')
box('RW_End_L',(-0.75,-1.95,0.85),(0.03,0.3,0.2),'CarDark')
box('RW_End_R',(0.75,-1.95,0.85),(0.03,0.3,0.2),'CarDark')
box('RW_Pylon',(0,-1.75,0.75),(0.04,0.08,0.2),'CarDark')
# wheels
for nm,x,y,r,w in [('FL',-0.95,1.55,0.33,0.16),('FR',0.95,1.55,0.33,0.16),('RL',-1.0,-1.35,0.38,0.22),('RR',1.0,-1.35,0.38,0.22)]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=10,radius=r,depth=w*2,location=(x,y,r),rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name='Wheel_'+nm; o.parent=root; o.data.materials.append(D.materials['Tire'])
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6,radius=r*0.5,depth=w*2+0.02,location=(x,y,r),rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name='Hub_'+nm; o.parent=root; o.data.materials.append(D.materials['CarDark'])
# suspension arms
for y in (1.55,-1.35):
    box('Arm_%s'%y,(0,y,0.35),(0.95,0.03,0.02),'CarDark')
for o in root.children:
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
print(len(root.children))

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene; D=bpy.data
root=D.objects['RaceCar']
for o in root.children:
    bm=bmesh.new(); bm.from_mesh(o.data); bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces); bm.to_mesh(o.data); bm.free()
# path: bottom straight -> corner -> right straight
R=10; path=[]
for i in range(46): path.append(Vector((-15+i,-20)))
for i in range(1,25):
    a=-math.pi/2+(math.pi/2)*i/24; path.append(Vector((30+R*math.cos(a),-10+R*math.sin(a))))
for i in range(1,16): path.append(Vector((40,-10+i)))
L=[0]
for i in range(1,len(path)): L.append(L[-1]+(path[i]-path[i-1]).length)
tot=L[-1]
def sample(s):
    for i in range(1,len(L)):
        if L[i]>=s:
            f=(s-L[i-1])/(L[i]-L[i-1]); return path[i-1].lerp(path[i],f),(path[i]-path[i-1]).normalized()
    return path[-1],(path[-1]-path[-2]).normalized()
sc.frame_start,sc.frame_end=1,120; sc.render.fps=24
root.animation_data_clear()
wheels=[o for o in root.children if o.name.startswith(('Wheel_','Hub_'))]
for w in wheels: w.rotation_mode='ZYX'; w.animation_data_clear()
prev_h=None
for fr in range(1,121):
    t=(fr-1)/119
    s=tot*(0.5*t+0.5*(t*t*(3-2*t)))  # mild ease
    p,d=sample(s)
    h=math.atan2(d.y,d.x)-math.pi/2
    if prev_h is not None:
        while h-prev_h>math.pi: h-=2*math.pi
        while h-prev_h<-math.pi: h+=2*math.pi
    prev_h=h
    root.location=(p.x,p.y,0); root.rotation_euler=(0,0,h)
    root.keyframe_insert('location',frame=fr); root.keyframe_insert('rotation_euler',frame=fr)
    for w in wheels:
        r=0.33 if w.name[-2]=='F' else 0.38
        w.rotation_euler=(0,math.pi/2,-s/r)
        w.keyframe_insert('rotation_euler',frame=fr)
for o in [root]+wheels:
    for fc in o.animation_data.action.fcurves if hasattr(o.animation_data.action,'fcurves') else []:
        for k in fc.keyframe_points: k.interpolation='LINEAR'
